title: Puttering Puzzle Puffer
statement: Beneath a canopy of luminous indigo kelp, this plump little architect spends its days nudging shards of sea glass into neat symmetries and blowing gentle jets of water to carve ever-shifting labyrinths into the silver sand. Whenever a visitor leans close, it pauses its meticulous tinkering to hover at eye level, fluttering its translucent fins while rippling with warm, golden bioluminescence.
